oracle_text: Whenever a creature you control with power 1 or less attacks, this enchantment deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker that creature is attacking.

trigger.description: Whenever a creature you control with power 1 or less attacks, ~ deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker that creature is attacking.

finding: 'deals 1 damage to the player or planeswalker that creature is attacking' parses to DealDamage with target Or[ParentTarget, Typed(Planeswalker)]; an Attacks trigger has no parent target, so the damage resolves to nobody. The issue's proposed fix lowers the target to DefendingPlayer.
